retrieved_chunks.title: Duke University Durham
retrieved_chunks.text:
more than 15,000 students in undergraduate, graduate, and professional programs.

Duke University Libraries (including Perkins and Bostock on West Campus) are in Durham. They are not the DKU Library at No. 8 Duke Avenue, Kunshan. This note does not list Perkins closing times, because those hours are not copied here.

DKU is described on Duke's international activity list alongside Duke-NUS in Singapore.

retrieved_chunks.title: Dku About
retrieved_chunks.text:
Duke Kunshan University (DKU) is a liberal arts and research university in Kunshan, Jiangsu, China. It was established in September 2013 as a U.S.-China partnership between Duke University and Wuhan University.

DKU welcomed its first students in August 2014, beginning with Duke graduate degrees and a Global Learning Semester. The four-year undergraduate bachelor's program began in August 2018.

retrieved_chunks.title: Dku Library Handbook 2021
retrieved_chunks.text:
as historical text. It does not describe the current dedicated library building.

In this 2021 handbook, the DKU Library is described as occupying two rooms on the first and second floor of the Academic Building. The listed phone number is (0512) 3665-7027. The listed email is dkulibrary@dukekunshan.edu.cn. The handbook also mentions a joint service relationship with Duke University Libraries (DUL).

retrieved_chunks.title: Registrar Fall 2026
retrieved_chunks.text:
DKU Registrar — Fall 2026 dates

Undergraduate and graduate classes begin Monday, 24 August 2026.

New international undergraduate students (Class of 2030) and international first-year graduate students move in Friday, 14 August 2026 at 09:00. New Chinese undergraduate and Chinese first-year graduate students move in Sunday, 16 August 2026 at 09:00. Returning students move in Friday, 21 August 2026 at 09:00.
